The '''Shadow Dagger''' is a [[Weapons#Daggers|dagger weapon]] that is a possible reward from the chest on floor 80 of [[the Mines]] if "remixed" mine rewards are selected in the [[Options|Advanced Options]] menu when starting a new game. It is also a possible drop when [[The Mines#Crates and Barrels|breaking boxes and barrels]] on floors 60-79, and on floors 100 and lower.

==History==
{{History|1.5|Previously unobtainable weapon introduced as remixed mine reward and crates and barrels drop. Level lowered from 8 to 4 and sell price lowered from {{Price|400}} to {{Price|200}}.}}
